attackers_goals: Export the content of a mailbox, preparing for data exfiltration.
description: An attacker may use PowerShell to export the contents of a mailbox as part of the data staging before exfiltration.
investigative_actions: Examine the PowerShell command to identify which mailbox has been exported. Verify that this command was executed by a trusted source.
name: PowerShell used to export mailbox contents
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
